name: Hakuto Tsukushi
source: Third-year high school student and [url=/c10367]Ayano's[/url] friend. She cares about Ayano more than anyone, because of this, she only holds a hostile attitude towards [url=/c10457]Haruto[/url]. Because she wants to protect Ayano from Haruto, she forcibly moves in with them.
